current_error_contract.single_item_apply_message: Validates completed identity, text byte budget, item count and metadata budget before mutating that item.
current_error_contract.current_complete_turn_defect: Calls apply_message directly on retained self/output for each item. An early valid item is committed before a later item returns Err, so complete_turn does not currently offer a whole-summary no-mutation guarantee.
current_error_contract.counterexample: Start with retained streamed text. Process a new valid completed item, then an item whose text alone is MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES. The second item returns output byte limit exceeded; the first item text and completed marker remain in current code.
current_error_contract.second_counterexample: A new valid item followed by conflicting text for an already completed ID returns completed agent message changed its text after retaining the first new item.
current_error_contract.live_call_site: observe_event validates the exact thread/turn/transport terminal receipt, calls complete_turn with ?, then updates terminal status, boundary, digest and terminal_observed. A summary failure can therefore mutate text/helper state while leaving terminal fields uncommitted.
current_error_contract.outer_failure_handling: run_once classifies the error, sets stop_reason and durably settles a clone of output before cleanup. It does not roll back partial summary text, so the static defect reaches the failure record.
current_error_contract.reconciliation_call_site: terminal_message_from_observed_response already uses a temporary output and temporary helper, so a failed read does not mutate its input output. The helper repair is still valid there.
error_strings_preserved: completed agent message changed its text

draft_repair.regression_oracle: Compare the entire NativeRunOutput before/after Err, then send a real delta for the first attempted new ID. Successful retry with only the original text plus retry proves no failed-batch text, ID ordering or completed marker leaked.
